points.claim: 提出一种基于图摘要的大规模时序图表示学习方法GSAERU，通过图摘要压缩图快照、图自编码器训练节点表征并结合循环神经网络学习时序依赖，实现高效生成大规模时序图的高质量表征。
points.claim_en: Propose a large-scale sequential graph representation learning method GSAERU based on graph summarization, which compresses graph snapshots via graph summarization, trains node representations with a graph autoencoder, and integrates a recurrent neural network to learn temporal dependencies, efficiently generating high-quality representations of large-scale sequential graphs.
technical_features: 将动态时序图建模为各时刻原图快照的序列
通过图摘要技术对原图进行压缩
将压缩后的新图输入图自编码器，利用重构误差训练原图节点表征
通过循环神经网络学习时间维度上的特征信息与依赖关系
technical_features_en: Model dynamic sequential graph as a sequence of snapshots at each time step
Compress the original graph via graph summarization technology
Input the compressed new graph into a graph autoencoder and train representations of original nodes using reconstruction error
Learn temporal feature information and dependencies via a recurrent neural network
source_locations: 论文摘要中关于GSAERU模型的段落
论文英文摘要中关于GSAERU模型的段落

points.claim: 提出一种基于图摘要的分布式图神经网络优化训练算法DSGNN，采用“领导-工作者”模式，领导节点利用基于边分割的图流划分算法划分原图，工作节点执行基于图摘要的小批量训练并通过注意力层返回结果，领导节点汇总梯度并同步更新所有节点模型，加速GNN训练并提升链路预测F1分数。
points.claim_en: Propose a distributed graph neural network optimization training algorithm DSGNN based on graph summarization, which adopts a leader-worker mode. The leader partitions the original graph using an edge-based graph streaming partitioning algorithm, workers perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization and return results through an attention layer, and the leader aggregates gradients and synchronously updates all node models, accelerating GNN training and improving link prediction F1 score.
technical_features: 采用“领导-工作者”分布式训练模式
领导节点利用基于边分割的图流划分算法对原图进行划分
工作节点执行基于图摘要的小批量训练
工作节点通过注意力层将训练结果返回给领导节点
领导节点汇总结果并计算梯度，同步更新所有计算节点上的模型
technical_features_en: Adopt a leader-worker distributed training mode
Leader partitions original graph using an edge-based graph streaming partitioning algorithm
Workers perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization
Workers return training results to leader through an attention layer
Leader aggregates results, computes gradient, and synchronously updates models on all computing nodes
source_locations: 论文摘要中关于DSGNN模型的段落
论文英文摘要中关于DSGNN模型的段落

points.claim: 提出了一种基于图摘要的大规模图压缩技术，通过构建摘要图对原始图进行有效压缩，在保留关键结构信息的同时显著降低图的规模，从而减少图神经网络训练所需的计算和存储开销，可作为高效训练的基础技术。
points.claim_en: Propose a large-scale graph compression technique based on graph summarization, which constructs a summarized graph to effectively compress the original graph while retaining key structural information, significantly reducing the graph scale and thereby decreasing computational and storage overhead for graph neural network training, serving as a foundation for efficient training.
technical_features: 通过图摘要技术构建摘要图
摘要图保留原图的关键结构信息
降低图的规模以减小计算和存储开销
technical_features_en: Construct a summarized graph via graph summarization technology
Preserve key structural information of the original graph in the summarized graph
Reduce graph scale to lower computational and storage overhead
source_locations: 论文摘要中关于图摘要技术的描述
